sql: select safe_cast(o.customer_id as string) as customer_id, o.total from `analytics.orders` as o qualify row_number() over (partition by o.customer_id order by o.created_at desc) = 1
select o.customer_id, iff(o.total > 0, o.total, 0) as net_total from analytics.orders as o qualify row_number() over (partition by o.customer_id order by o.created_at desc) = 1
select cast(o.customer_id as string) as customer_id, explode(o.items) as item from analytics.orders as o
select o.customer_id, o.payload ->> 'status' as status from analytics.orders as o
select o.customer_id, list_sum(o.amounts) as total from analytics.orders as o
